title: The determinant of a square matrix of C^m functions is C^m (Leibniz formula; parent Step 2)
statement: Let k, n ∈ ℕ and let m ∈ WithTop ℕ∞ be any smoothness order in the sense of Mathlib's ContDiff: a finite order, m = ∞ (C^∞), or m = ω (real analytic). For t, s ∈ Fin n let M_{t,s} : ℝ^k → ℝ (M : Fin n → Fin n → Eucl k → ℝ) be functions, each of class C^m. Then the function w ↦ det(M_{t,s}(w))_{t,s ∈ Fin n}, the determinant of the n×n real matrix Matrix.of (fun t s => M t s w), is of class C^m on ℝ^k = Eucl k. For n = 0 this function is the constant 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (k n : ℕ) (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (M : Fin n → Fin n → Eucl k → ℝ), (∀ t s, ContDiff ℝ m (M t s)) → ContDiff ℝ m (fun w => Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin n => M t s w))
